name: Efficient Ray Casting Pipeline
definition: A multi-pass D3D11 pipeline for volume raycasting using geometry shaders for active brick detection and ray generation, with separate buffers for output, far/near positions, and debug visualization.
summary: Efficient Ray Casting Pipeline is a rendering system offering either a CPU-based 2D engine or a GPU-based 3D volume pipeline, distinguished by prioritizing predictable, low-latency operations for real-time performance.
